nodes.description: address public owner; authoritative owner of the Owned/TropiDoge contract, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
address public newOwner; pending owner used by the two-step ownership transfer.
string public symbol, token ticker set in the TropiDoge constructor.
string public name, token name set in the TropiDoge constructor.
uint8 public decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
uint public _totalSupply; total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances; core ledger mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure; checked addition used for crediting balances.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure; checked subtraction used for debiting balances and allowances.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure; checked multiplication (unused by token logic).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure; checked division (unused by token logic).
Owned() constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; stages newOwner for the two-step transfer.
acceptOwnership() public; requires msg.sender == newOwner and then moves ownership.
TropicalDoge() constructor; initializes metadata, supply and mints the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
totalSupply() public constant returns (uint); returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant; reads the balances mapping.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public; debits msg.sender and credits 'to' through SafeMath.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public; overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no zero-first check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public; moves balances and decrements the allowance of msg.sender.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant; reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public; sets the allowance and then performs an external call to spender.
function () public payable { revert(); } ; rejects all plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner; externally calls an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender; attacker-influenced caller identity used for ownership, balances and allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed inside approveAndCall after state updates.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) executed inside transferAnyERC20Token with an owner-controlled but arbitrary token address.
State write balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer.
State write allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) inside transferFrom.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership; address staged as newOwner.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf; address whose balance is read.
Parameter 'to' of transfer; recipient of the tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer; amount debited from msg.sender.
Parameter 'spender' of approve; address granted the allowance.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve; allowance amount written to allowed.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom; source account debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom; destination account credited.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom; amount moved and deducted from the allowance.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance; owner side of the allowance lookup.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance; spender side of the allowance lookup.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall; mutated into the allowance and then externally called.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall; allowance amount and payload of the callback.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall; attacker-controlled bytes forwarded to the external call.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token; arbitrary contract invoked by the owner.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token; amount passed to the external token call.
Parameter 'a' of safeAdd.
Parameter 'b' of safeAdd.
Parameter 'a' of safeSub.
Parameter 'b' of safeSub.
Parameter 'a' of safeMul.
Parameter 'b' of safeMul.
Parameter 'a' of safeDiv.
Parameter 'b' of safeDiv.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable inside the Owned constructor.
The onlyOwner modifier of transferOwnership enforces msg.sender == owner before staging newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender], so the caller identity drives the debited account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the caller identity.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approveAndCall stores allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender into the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier, which compares msg.sender to owner.
transfer executes the checked balance debit, representing the arithmetic-sensitive balances write.
transferFrom executes the checked allowance decrement on allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall performs the external spender.receiveApproval call after mutating the allowance state.
The externally called spender contract re-enters the token and acts with its own msg.sender identity.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an owner-supplied arbitrary token contract.
The arbitrary external token contract can call back into transferAnyERC20Token or other functions as msg.sender.
The Owned constructor writes the deployer address into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes _newOwner into the newOwner state variable after the onlyOwner check.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner after verifying msg.sender.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the ownership transfer.
The TropicalDoge constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed 10^33 initial supply.
The TropicalDoge constructor fully pre-mints balances at the hardcoded deployer address.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the burned balance at address(0).
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to discount burned tokens.
balanceOf returns the balances entry of the queried address.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for the sender and the recipient.
The unchecked-by-compiler SafeMath debit writes into balances[msg.sender].
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry for the caller and spender.
transferFrom updates the balances of 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] by the transferred amount.
The SafeMath allowance decrement writes into the allowed mapping.
allowance returns the allowed entry for tokenOwner and spender.
transfer delegates the balance debit to SafeMath.safeSub, which enforces b <= a.
transfer delegates the balance credit to SafeMath.safeAdd, which enforces no overflow.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance and the allowance decrements.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
_newOwner flows into transferOwnership and then into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner flows into balanceOf as the lookup key of the balances mapping.
'to' flows into transfer as the credited recipient.
'tokens' flows into transfer as the transferred amount.
'spender' flows into approve as the allowance key.
'tokens' flows into approve as the allowance value.
'from' flows into transferFrom as the debited account.
'to' flows into transferFrom as the credited account.
'tokens' flows into transferFrom as the moved amount.
tokenOwner flows into allowance as the outer mapping key.
'spender' flows into allowance as the inner mapping key.
'spender' flows into approveAndCall as the allowance key and the external call target.
'tokens' flows into approveAndCall as the allowance value and callback argument.
'data' flows into approveAndCall and is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress flows into transferAnyERC20Token as the arbitrary contract to invoke.
'tokens' flows into transferAnyERC20Token as the amount passed to the external token call.
'a' is the first operand of safeAdd.
'b' is the second operand of safeAdd.
'a' is the minuend of safeSub.
'b' is the subtrahend of safeSub.
'a' is the first operand of safeMul.
'b' is the second operand of safeMul.
'a' is the dividend of safeDiv.
'b' is the divisor of safeDiv.
The transfer amount parameter directly drives the checked balances debit, an arithmetic-sensitive write.
The transferFrom amount parameter drives the allowance decrement, an arithmetic-sensitive write.
The spender parameter becomes the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
The caller-supplied data parameter is forwarded into the external call, enabling malicious callback payloads.
The tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is forwarded to the untrusted external token contract call.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to be written into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership and can be folded into that function.
The parameter is a pure read key for the balances mapping and collapses into balanceOf.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by the transfer function's balances credit.
The amount parameter is only consumed by the transfer function's SafeMath debit.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowed mapping key inside approve.
The tokens parameter is only used as the allowed mapping value inside approve.
The from parameter only indexes the balances and allowed mappings inside transferFrom.
The to parameter only receives the credited balance inside transferFrom.
The tokens parameter only feeds the SafeMath debit and allowance decrement inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is only a read key of the allowed mapping inside allowance.
The spender parameter is only a read key of the allowed mapping inside allowance.
The spender parameter both keys the allowance and becomes the external call target in approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is only used as the allowance value and callback argument in approveAndCall.
The data parameter is only forwarded into the external receiveApproval call made by approveAndCall.
The tokenAddress parameter is only used to instantiate the external token interface inside transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is only forwarded to the external token transfer inside transferAnyERC20Token.
The first operand is only used inside the safeAdd addition and its overflow check.
The second operand is only used inside the safeAdd addition and its overflow check.
The minuend is only used inside the safeSub inequality check and subtraction.
The subtrahend is only used inside the safeSub inequality check and subtraction.
The first operand is only used inside the safeMul multiplication and consistency check.
The second operand is only used inside the safeMul multiplication and consistency check.
The dividend is only used inside the safeDiv division.
The divisor is only used inside the safeDiv division and its non-zero requirement.
